status: pre-registered before any policy comparison on the benchmark pool

split.ordering: sha256('solver-robustness-v1' | family | instance file sha256), ascending
split.full_reduction_reason: Gurobi WLS licence sustains two concurrent sessions; decided from the historical Base cost model before any policy run on the pool

hardware: ute partition, Intel nodes (--constraint=intel), 2 cores reserved per task

solver_settings.highs_note: HiGHS uses one MIP feasibility tolerance; primal_feasibility_tolerance and mip_feasibility_tolerance are both 1e-6

caps.rule_R1: T_F = smallest T in {1800, 3600, 7200} such that Base completes >= 80% at gap 1% and >= 70% at gap 0.1% for Gurobi (historical one-thread logs) and for CPLEX (pilot); otherwise 7200
caps.rule_R2: HiGHS runs family F in the primary campaign unless its pilot Base completion at T_F and gap 1% is below 50%; then HiGHS in F runs only on the multiseed subset with the primary seed

instance077_audit.runs: 3 solvers x 4 policies x 2 gaps x seeds {1,...,5} at the SG-Ter-Mer cap; plus Gurobi 16 threads seed 42 on the historical version
instance077_audit.extension: censored runs may be repeated at 2 x cap as a separate diagnostic that never changes primary outcomes

primary: PAR10 over the assigned pool (family x solver x gap)
secondary: paired runtime ratio (geometric mean, median) on instances completed by all four policies
solver-specific effort: Gurobi work units, CPLEX deterministic ticks, nodes and LP iterations
endpoints.verification_label: activity-normalized maximum row violation <= 1e-6, bound violations <= 1e-6, integrality <= 1e-5, no missing values
confirmatory_contrasts: C4 sign stability of C1-C2 across seeds
C5 stress experiment under CPLEX: budget vs budget-free paired discordance
endpoints.inference: within family x solver x gap; paired by instance; cluster bootstrap by instance; seeds and gaps are not independent replications

rerun_policy: only runs classified LICENSE_FAILURE or INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE (documented) are repeated; timeouts and solver errors are outcomes
